newsitem.title: UK: U.S.army awards Shorts $12.9 mln for missile test.
newsitem.headline: U.S.army awards Shorts $12.9 mln for missile test.

text.p: The U.S. army has awarded Shorts Missile Systems $12.9 million for the next phase of a test programme to evaluate Shorts' Starstreak missile for the Apache helicopter.
The Belfast company said in a statement that the award follows the succesful completion of a 17-month first phase.
Shorts, Lockheed Martin Electronics and Missiles and McDonnell Douglas Helicopter Systems conducted the tests, which ended on October 24.

In the next phase Starstreak's laser beam guidance system will be integrated into the Apache's Target Acqusition Designation Sight and the aircraft's advanced fire control system, allowing the pilot a fully automatic guidance capability.
The air-to-air Starstreak missile is designed to give the helicopter defensive capability to complement its air-to-ground attack role.
